text:
Situation: Carboplatin has been on the FDA shortage list since 2023-04-28, a span of 42 months as of 2026-10-21. Multiple manufacturers remain in shortage, including Accord Healthcare (supplied by Intas), Teva, Fresenius Kabi, Hospira/Pfizer, Eugia, Gland Pharma, Avyxa, and Teyro Labs. Corvale East holds 54 units of Teva product (NDC 00703423901) and 77 units of Apotex product (NDC 60505628201), providing 18 days of supply at current burn. Corvale Lakeside has only 4 units total, equating to roughly 2 days of supply. Corvale General holds approximately 76 units across three listings, providing 9 days of supply.

Why (FDA record): An FDA inspection of Intas Pharmaceuticals Limited (FEI 3004011473) concluded 2022-12-02 with an OAI classification; the classification letter is dated 2023-04-05, 23 days before the shortage posting. Import Alert 66-40 for Intas was published 2023-06-01 and again 2023-11-14, and a Warning Letter was issued 2023-07-28. These regulatory actions on a key supplier underlie the prolonged multi-manufacturer shortage.

Our position: Inventory is critically low at Corvale Lakeside and thin at Corvale General. Corvale East has sufficient buffer to support internal transfers without dropping below a two-week safety stock. P&T has previously approved interchange between the Teva and Apotex products (same product, alternate manufacturer) and between Accord and Teva (same molecule, alternate concentration or vial size).

Recommended actions:
1. Transfer 26 vials from Corvale East to Corvale Lakeside to raise Lakeside to approximately 14 days of supply while East retains two weeks. Approval required: Pharmacy Director (transfer request).
2. Transfer 2 vials from Corvale East to Corvale General to bolster General’s stock. Approval required: Pharmacy Director (transfer request).
3. Utilize the approved same-product, alternate-manufacturer substitution (Apotex Corp. carboplatin 10 mg/mL) per P&T approval by Alex Morgan, PharmD on 2026-05-16. Approval required: Pharmacist at point of dispensing.
4. Utilize the approved same-molecule, alternate-concentration/vial-size option (Teva Parenteral Medicines carboplatin 10 mg/mL) per P&T approval by Casey Nguyen, MD on 2026-01-18, with dose and volume recalculation and pharmacist verification. Approval required: Pharmacist at point of dispensing.
